name: Training Ray Marching and Integration
aliases: NeRF Forward Pass with Ray Marching and Accumulation
definition: Performs volume rendering for training, including ray generation, adaptive marching with occupancy grid pruning, neural network evaluation, and alpha compositing.
summary: Training Ray Marching and Integration is a differentiable forward pass that synthesizes images from neural radiance fields using stochastic perturbations and adaptive sampling to enable gradient-based learning.
